name: Debate-Based Career Guidance Agent with Complementary Personas
description: Create planner, critic and ethics-reviewer personas that debate career options using public course and role data, then produce a balanced recommendation with uncertainty and human override. Avoiding one-sided advice, transparency of disagreement, fairness and calibrated uncertainty.
tech_stack: Chroma / FAISS (Public ACM course & O*NET role data)
Streamlit (Interactive prototype, debate trace viewer & human override)
conventions: Planner, Critic, and Ethics-Reviewer personas orchestrated by a Moderator Synthesizer
Grounded evidence retrieval linking claims to public course curricula and O*NET standards
42-node Neo4j prerequisite DAG validation enforcing topological sequencing
Calibrated uncertainty estimation explicitly combining persona friction, prerequisite penalties, and socioeconomic risk
Transparent Dispute Tree extraction exposing explicit contention forks
Interactive Human Override panel allowing students and counselors to reweight priorities and approve roadmaps
Strict RAI counterfactual fairness evaluation across paired synthetic demographic profiles
architecture_patterns: Multi-persona dialectic debate (Planner, Critic, Ethics-Reviewer, Moderator)
Public course and role data retrieval via ChromaDB
Graph verification via Neo4j Cypher and NetworkX topological checks
Calibrated epistemic uncertainty scoring and Dispute Tree generation
evaluation_metrics: Evidence diversity (Shannon entropy over cited course/role domains)
Contradiction-resolution rate (Percentage of Critic/Ethics objections resolved)
Unsupported-claim rate (Percentage of milestones violating prerequisite DAG or lacking citations)
Fairness across synthetic profiles (Jaccard similarity across counterfactual pairs)
User-rubric score (1.0 to 5.0 across balance, rigor, equity, transparency, and override)
deliverables: Debate trace viewer (Interactive round-by-round persona inspect)
Synthetic profile set (20 profiles across 10 base archetypes with paired variants)
Comparative evaluation (Benchmark comparing 4 configurations across all 5 metrics)

file_structure.app.py: Streamlit multi-persona prototype, debate trace viewer, graph visualizer & override panel
file_structure.run_study.py: Comparative evaluation study runner executing the benchmark across all 20 profiles
file_structure.generate_deck.py: Presentation deck generator compiling Final_Presentation.pptx and PDF
file_structure.src/agents/: Planner, Critic, Ethics-Reviewer, and Moderator multi-agent harness
file_structure.src/graph/: Neo4j career-skill graph (42-node prerequisite DAG & Cypher generator)
file_structure.src/rag/: Chroma vector store indexing public courses and roles
file_structure.src/eval/: Comparative evaluation engine calculating the 5 official metrics

never_do: Never generate monolithic, one-sided career advice without adversarial critique
Never drop unresolved ethical, financial, or prerequisite contradictions from the final synthesis
Never emit uncalibrated 100% confidence career trajectories
Never suppress human override or force autonomous career decisions
Never produce hallucinated career shortcuts without prerequisite graph verification
preferred_patterns: Practice extreme token economy: dense, high-signal, academic-grade rigor
Structured JSON output schemas for all agent debate turns
Deterministic graph verification coupled with grounded vector retrieval
